2607.08054.title: Who Analyses the Analyser? Self-Validating LLM Hazard Analysis with Constitutional Meta-STPA
2607.08054.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted to draft the artifacts of safety analysis such as, losses, hazards, Unsafe Control Actions (UCAs), and safety constraints, inside rigorous processes such as Systems-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA). Yet a blind spot runs through this fast-growing literature: every system gets analysed except the LLM-assisted tool doing the analysing, which is itself a safety-relevant system that can hallucinate standards, emit unverifiable constraints, and leave no audit trail from prompt to artifact. We take seriously the question the field has skipped -- {who analyses the analyser?} and answer it by turning STPA on the tool itself. We present \{Constitutional Meta-STPA}, an LLM-assisted STPA tool built around a closed loop: the tool runs a {meta-STPA} of the class of AI-assisted safety tools and {derives} rather than asserts, its governance constitution from the resulting loss$\to$hazard$\to$UCA$\to$constraint chain, yielding a published constitution of $21$ Tool Principles and $8$ Meta-Safety Principles, each bound to a code enforcement point. We formalise the measured object as a constitution-marginal coverage operator over a principle set $P$ ($|P|{=}29$) with a soundness lemma that isolates coverage from model and scanner, and report four findings. {(i)~Self-derivation:} a frontier ensemble ({claude-opus-4.8}${+}${claude-sonnet-4}) recovers $18/21$ canonical and all $8/8$ governance principles from the tool's own design, while a weaker pair recovers $12/21$ and $3/8$, so the meta layer is model-limited, not constitution-limited, and the same $8/8$ re-emerge from a second, independently authored tool.
2607.08054.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越被信任用於草擬安全分析的產物，例如損失、危害、不安全控制行為（UCAs）和安全約束，在嚴謹的過程中，例如系統理論過程分析（STPA）。然而，在這個快速增長的文獻中存在一個盲點：每個系統都被分析，除了進行分析的LLM輔助工具，該工具本身就是一個安全相關的系統，可能會產生虛幻的標準、發出無法驗證的約束，並且從提示到產物沒有任何審計痕跡。我們認真對待這個被該領域忽略的問題——{誰分析分析者？}並通過將STPA應用於工具本身來回答這個問題。我們提出了\{憲法元STPA\}，這是一個圍繞閉環構建的LLM輔助STPA工具：該工具對AI輔助安全工具的類別進行{元STPA}，並從結果的損失$\to$危害$\to$UCA$\to$約束鏈中{推導}而不是斷言其治理憲法，產生了$21$條工具原則和$8$條元安全原則的已發表憲法，每一條都與代碼執行點相連。我們將測量對象形式化為一個原則集$P$（$|P|{=}29$）上的憲法邊際覆蓋運算符，並提供了一個隔離覆蓋與模型和掃描器的健全性引理，並報告了四個發現。{(i)~自我推導：}一個前沿集成（{claude-opus-4.8}${+}${claude-sonnet-4}）從工具自身的設計中恢復了$18/21$條典型原則和所有$8/8$條治理原則，而一對較弱的工具恢復了$12/21$和$3/8$，因此元層是模型有限的，而不是憲法有限的，同樣的$8/8$又從第二個獨立創作的工具中重新出現。
